params.body:
Part 2 of 3 of "one file per finding". Background and the full change are in part 3 (docs/one-file-per-finding); this part only adds the rows 56 to 110 of the 127 of `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md` as files under `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/`, `YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` with frontmatter (`id: X-nn` kept for every migrated row) and the two prose cells as paragraphs.

Nothing reads that directory yet: the tables stay, `bin/rules-page` and `RulesIdentityTest` keep reading them, so main stays green in between. Part 1 (docs/findings-files-1) adds the first 55 and is independent of this one (both branch from main, different files). Part 3 adds the last rows, the open points, the READMEs, the generator and the test, and deletes the two tables.

Why three: one push of 170 files exceeds the control gateway's 60-second budget for a GitHub effect (four attempts, each reaching the tree or the commit step and then timing out). Merge order: 1, 2, then 3 (3 shows the files of 1 and 2 in its diff until they merge).
params.title: Findings as files, part 2 of 3: rows 56 to 110
